about_short_description.short_description: Penguin AI builds AI sales reps for website intent signals

product.name: Lead Feed
product.description: Identifies and engages anonymous leads on your site by revealing their company and contact information.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: Automates the qualification, scoring, and outreach to high-intent website visitors.

product.name: AI Chat
product.description: Provides instant answers to prospect queries on your website using AI, capturing intent data for conversion into demos.

product.name: Question Feed
product.description: Allows sorting and querying of prospect chats to personalize outreach based on the pages they visited and questions asked.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: Tracks conversion rates and engagement metrics, offering insights into visitor behavior and ROI.
